summary: The badSink in 71b reads array[data] after only checking the upper bound (data < array.length). Since data comes from SecureRandom().nextInt(), it can be negative, causing an out-of-bounds array access (CWE-129). Fixed by also validating the lower bound (data >= 0) before indexing, matching the pattern of the reference fix which checks the index against both bounds before use. Valid indices 0-4 still work.
